===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Rockchip]] RV1106G3 @1.2GHz :ARM (Cortex-A7), NPU: 1 TOPS INT4/INT8/INT16 :VPU 5M@30fps H.265/H.264 encoding, 16M@60FPS JPEG snapshot *Storage: 8GB eMMC flash *Memory: 256MB (DDR3L) RAM (integrated SiP) *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet (100M) port *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C), 1x USB 2.0 (Host) ports *GPIO: 2x 26-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port or :802.3af via optional PoE Hat
